name: litwindow
description: litwindow: a small C++ library collection (lwbase core utilities, optional ODBC data-access and wxWidgets UI integration).

odbc.description: Build the litwindow ODBC data-access library. On Linux the ODBC driver manager (unixODBC) is expected to be installed via the system package manager (e.g. apt-get install unixodbc-dev), not vcpkg, so this feature adds no extra vcpkg dependencies of its own.

wx.description: Build the lwwx wxWidgets UI integration library
